meta.title: Funda extension — WoonReality
meta.description: Install the WoonReality extension for Chrome, Edge or Firefox and save Funda features to your file.

page.title: Store Funda facts with your home.
page.heroCopy: Install the extension once. Then open a Funda listing in your own browser and save only the relevant features with your home check.
page.extractArchive: Unpack the archive into a folder you keep.
page.loadUnpacked: Choose “Load unpacked” and select that folder.
page.updateNote: With a new version, download the zip again and choose “Refresh” on the extensions page.
page.firefoxDevPart2: → “Load Temporary Add-on” and choose the XPI or
page.tempAddonNote: Temporary add-ons disappear after a restart. A signed XPI or AMO publication persists.
